name: io.github.yanlong-iao/ultimate-prompt-optimizer
title: Ultimate Prompt Optimizer
description: Prompt engineering workbench: candidate prompts, LangGPT structuring, iterative optimization, promptfoo-style evals, DSPy-style search.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for your OpenAI-compatible provider (optional for a localhost endpoint such as Ollama)

environmentVariables.name: LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com or http://localhost:11434/v1

environmentVariables.name: LLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model id used by every tool, e.g. deepseek-flash

environmentVariables.name: JUDGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional stronger model for graders and the pairwise judge

environmentVariables.name: UPO_MAX_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on API calls per tool run
